in_sanskrit.name: Faijal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious, Conqueror
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Faijal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Faijal is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vijay' which means 'victorious' or 'conqueror'. This name is bestowed upon a child who is destined to be a leader and a winner in life.
